heading: Drop some SOL
intro: Enter the amount of SOL to send. The recipient can claim the drop later, even if they do not have a wallet yet. Dropsome creates a claim link they can use when they are ready.

link.heading: Share this claim link
link.warningBody: The funds are already sent, and this link is your golden ticket! Make sure you've copied it before closing, or the receiver won't be able to claim. If you missed it, you'll need to refund the drop and start over.

toast.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
